name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Path Intelligence — Source-Aware Planning
features: Added Talent Path Intelligence using only Blizzard-reported locked_by references
Included a read-only dashboard for planned talents, source-linked nodes, potential review flags and unresolved references
Added cycle-safe upstream talent path inspection up to 16 levels
Added an optional filter to focus on nodes with points allocated but a reported source link that has zero planned points
Distinguished review prompts from full in-game prerequisite and point-budget validation
Preserved all existing v2.6 Talent Forge draft storage, Loot Hunter, Armory, Item Codex and planning studios
Kept Cloudflare API routes and Blizzard secrets unchanged; no Worker redeployment required
